Arnold Schwarzenegger Upholds Fitness Routine as He Celebrates 78th Birthday
A bicycle ride, weightlifting, and ’some good food,‘ were all on tap as the seven-time Mr. Olympia and two-term governor kept on ’working to get better.’

Actor and former California Gov. Arnold Schwarzenegger marked his 78th birthday on July 30 with a workout, reaffirming his longstanding commitment to health and fitness.
In a
video
posted to his Instagram account, Schwarzenegger was seen riding a bicycle, and expressed plans to lift weights and enjoy a meal as part of his birthday routine.
